title: Family Picnic in Forest, 1930s Vintage Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1930s sepia snapshot capturing a family enjoying an outdoor picnic at a wooden table nestled among forest trees. An older man wearing a straw fedora sits on the bench looking at the camera, while three women in period dresses and hats gather around the picnic spread. A metal thermos, milk bottle, and wooden crate sit nearby, illustrating middle-class American outdoor leisure during the Great Depression era.
